blurb: Guests take approximately one-hour hot air balloon flights at sunrise or sunset, experiencing scenic views of Chester County's rolling hills and farmlands. Flights include a Champagne toast and optional add-ons like professional photography, meals, and overnight stays. Tethered balloon flights and special event services are also offered.
